visualCharacteristics.purpose: Large image next to a stacked list of icon + label + link items
visualCharacteristics.description: Two 50/50 columns on desktop (stacked on mobile): left a large full-width image, right a vertical list of rows, each a small outline icon beside a grey label line and a bold link with an arrow.

contentPattern.structure: Row 0: one cell with the large image (block field image + imageAlt). Rows 1..N: one Icon Item each: icon image cell | richtext cell (label line, line break, bold link)

reuseGuidance: Use when one large image sits next to a short stack (2-4) of icon + text + link items. For purely textual side-by-side groups use columns-features.
